in_hebrew.name: גרנטם
in_hebrew.long_meaning: A name derived from the Hebrew word גרן (ger) which means 'stranger' or 'foreigner', and the suffix תם (tam) which means 'completeness' or 'perfection'. The name Grantham may be interpreted as 'completeness of the stranger' or 'perfection of the traveler'.

in_greek.name: Γρανθάμ
in_greek.long_meaning: The name Grantham in Greek is derived from the Greek word ξενίτης (xenites) which means 'stranger' or 'foreigner', and the suffix αμενός (amenos) which means 'unwavering' or 'reliable'. The name Grantham in Greek may be interpreted as 'unwavering stranger' or 'reliable foreigner'.

in_latin.name: Granthamus
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Grantham in Latin is derived from the Latin word peregrinus which means 'stranger' or 'foreigner', and the suffix us which denotes a person. The name Grantham in Latin may be interpreted as 'person who is a stranger' or 'person who is a foreigner'.
